items.title: MECH-357 agent-directed hazard pursuit Stage-H retest (6th pressure candidate; 603s+directedness)
items.note: 6th and final pressure-mechanism candidate for the MECH-357 Stage-H readiness test. 603u = 603s + DIRECTEDNESS: keeps 603s mobile drift (env_drift_interval=1/prob=0.6) and adds hazard_agent_pursuit=0.9 (single isolated change vs 603s) so a moving hazard chases the agent's current cell, removing 603s's spawn-lottery confound (undirected drift -> exact tie G_H_INTACT=G_H_LESION=0.6667; 603t scheduled adjacency -> LESION ceiling 1.0). PRIMARY: G_H_INTACT>=2/3 AND G_H_INTACT_frac>G_H_LESION_frac; two-sided headroom guard self-routes a mis-calibrated pressure to substrate_not_ready_requeue. CLEARS MECH-357 re-derive brake (count=2: 603s 2026-08-10, 603t 2026-08-13): the 603t autopsy recommended_substrate_queue_entry names this exact build; env primitive hazard_agent_pursuit landed ree-v3 39b5ca8, Stage-H threading landed this session (intelligent-elgamal-222d2b). GOV-REUSE-1: agent-directed pursuit is a new manipulation in no recorded manifest -> ran fresh. 2.5c: runs under known DEGRADING defect SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING on causal_grid_world.py (non-blocking). The avoidance_efficacy eligibility-trace leak:learn imbalance is filed as a SEPARATE substrate_queue line item; it does not confound the G_H window (scaffold_floor covers Stage-H). Design doc: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/mech357_agent_pursuit_build_2026-08-14.md.

items.title: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING validation: dedicated proximity signal safe-vs-unsafe AUC vs damage-sourced z_harm_a
items.note: Diagnostic validation of SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (landed ree-v3 b257e7ad14). Measures BOTH candidate MECH-303 gate signals per tick under the production scenario (limb_damage_enabled=True) that V3-EXQ-917 showed defeats z_harm_a: the DEDICATED proximity signal obs_dict['safety_proximity_harm'] (C1, load-bearing) vs damage-sourced z_harm_a.norm() (C2, control). Acceptance: dedicated signal clears a reachable+discriminating threshold (AUC>=0.75 bar; ~0.84 target) the damage-sourced signal cannot. Smoke PASS: dedicated_best_auc=1.0 on 2seed/20tick, mean signal safe(h0)=0.00 vs unsafe(h8)=0.36, z_harm_a flat ~0.54 across density. GOV-REUSE-1: dedicated signal did not exist before b257e7ad14 -> no prior manifest carries this readout, ran fresh. ID note: originally drafted as V3-EXQ-929 but that id was taken concurrently by the sleep GAP-9 session (coordinator DB race); moved to 930.
